freeze_boundary.first_eligible_post_freeze_contest: abc485 and strictly subsequent ABC contests after frozen_timestamp_utc
freeze_boundary.secondary_accumulation_series: Codeforces Div. 2 (Regular Div.2 + Educational Div.2), strictly within-series pairing

candidate_model_set: llm_deepseek_v4_1_flash_1017 (fixed temperature=0, locked single-item prompt SHA-256, tracked via 20 fixed dev anchors)

pre_freeze_locked_selectors.development_window: ABC 2025 complete calendar year (18 blocks; 166 within-position / 1,162 pooled valid pairs)
pre_freeze_locked_selectors.tie_breaking_rule: Deterministic preference for simpler/lower-parameter family on exact tie (length < structure < text < joint < pw_joint < bert < bge_mean < bge_cls < llm)

frozen_cf_all8_modern_selectors.same_winner_G_zero_rule: If an alternative fixed selector pair selects the exact same model under both protocols, report G = 0.00 pp explicitly rather than omitting the observation or dropping the comparison.

pairing_and_scoring_rules.adjacent_block_rule: Chronological non-overlapping pairs (1,2), (3,4) within platform & series; trailing unmatched odd contest held until next contest completes a block
pairing_and_scoring_rules.prediction_sealing_sla: Within 24 hours after contest end (and strictly before rating merge), snapshot raw HTML/sections -> run p3-proto-v2 parser & frozen models + locked LLM API -> write SHA-256 to step7_sealing_ledger.jsonl
pairing_and_scoring_rules.label_harvest_sla: Separate Day +14 post-contest fetch of AtCoder Problems problem-models.json (community integer difficulty; raw negative difficulties retained without clipDifficulty); fallback Day +21 if unrated/delayed

estimands.primary_estimand: ABC post-freeze within-position G = A_same(within-position-selected model) − A_same(pooled-selected model) in percentage points, evaluated across post-freeze adjacent-contest blocks with B=2,000 block bootstrap CIs
secondary_estimands: LLM minus Joint Ridge (A_same difference and D)
BGE-Mean & Pairwise RankNet minus Joint Ridge (A_same and D)
BoW Text minus Length D (replication tracking; preserving E1's pre-locked D for E1's own historical identity)

practical_horizon_plan.planned_pilot_horizon: 10–12 blocks (20–24 ABC contests, ~5–6 months at ~1 contest/week), expected unconditional G 95% CI half-width +/-8 to +/-14 pp -> explicitly presented as a per-contest sealed prospective pilot with wide intervals
practical_horizon_plan.target_precision_reference: Reaching +/-5 pp half-width on ABC G requires ~60–91 blocks (~120–182 contests); reaching +/-3 pp requires >200 blocks (comparable in scale to p10 historical simulations: ~239 blocks for ABC BoW-Len D, ~344 blocks for CF Joint-Surface same-slot gain)

maintainer_workload_logging_schema.goal: Estimate empirical within-position proportion w_obs from a fixed collection window and reweight observed stratum accuracies Delta_same, Delta_diff into Delta(w_obs) = w_obs*Delta_same + (1 - w_obs)*Delta_diff (using 77.9% zero-crossing as fixed-stratum scenario benchmark).
